newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's city of Lublin sells PLN 11 mln munibonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland's city of Lublin sells PLN 11 mln munibonds.

text.p: The southeastern Polish city of Lublin sold 11 million zlotys of three-year bonds from its 15 million zloty offer, Bank Depozytowo-Kredytowy SA in Lublin (BDK), the issue's manager and dealer, told Reuters on Friday.
It sold index-linked paper at a minimum price of 100.01 and a maximum yield of 20.8 percent after investors bid for 11 million zlotys of the bonds.
The annual coupon of the bonds is calculated as the average yield of 52-week T-bills from the two primary auctions preceding the interest period, plus a 100 basis points margin. @

The sale was a second tranche of a one- and three-year programme of issuing municipal bonds, under which Lublin may raise up to 90 million zlotys by the year 2000 for public transport purchases and modernisation.
At the first auction held in October, BDK sold one-year bonds at an average yield of 20.26 percent.
